segments.text: Quick one. A bat and a ball cost one dollar ten. The bat costs a dollar more than the ball. How much is the ball?
You just thought ten cents. Almost everyone does. And it's wrong.
It's five cents. Your fast brain grabbed the easy answer and never passed it to the slow brain that checks the math.
That hand-off failing is the whole book. You're not dumb. You're just on autopilot more than you think.
That's Thinking, Fast and Slow. Honest verdict on the channel.
